# Axiocairn MCP

> Retrieve published market research reports, their data dates, and their limitations through a hosted MCP server.

Research information, not investment advice. Account authorization is required. Access follows account permissions. Client compatibility must be checked individually. Retrieval covers existing reports; report generation on request is not claimed here.

## Connect

- General Streamable HTTP endpoint, verified in claude.ai web on 2026-10-27: https://axiocairn.com/mcp
- ChatGPT endpoint, verified in ChatGPT web on 2026-10-27: https://axiocairn.com/mcp/chatgpt
- Grok endpoint, verification pending: https://axiocairn.com/mcp/grok
- Muse endpoint, verification pending: https://axiocairn.com/mcp/muse
- [Connection guide](https://axiocairn.com/en/assistant): setup and account authorization steps.

## Tools

After authorization, use tools/list for current names, descriptions and input schemas. Unauthenticated discovery returns an authorization error.

- get_todays_reports: reports for today or a selected date.
- get_latest_report_by_type: newest available report in a selected family.
- search_report_archive: find published reports; report_type sample selects samples.
- get_report_schedule: expected times, time zone and recorded generation times.
- get_symbol_reports: list existing ticker reports, then retrieve a selected type. If a report is not available yet, the response says so and, where your plan allows, may offer to prepare it. Availability is rolling out.
- get_house_view: this week's weekly report and next expected publication date.

Preserve report links, data dates, missing fields and limitations. Expected publication times do not establish availability. Weekends and market holidays retain the latest trading day's data; today's report may be absent. Reader is the free tier, with limited look-ups, delayed briefs and limited history.
